cover: Escalating Gulf tanker strikes and widespread French riots rattle global security
cover_scene: A split composition showing an oil tanker burning fiercely at sea against dark smoke beside a silhouetted European city street illuminated by protest flares.

slides.scene: A commercial oil tanker engulfed in flames and thick black smoke drifting across the narrow waters of the Strait of Hormuz at dusk.
slides.headline: Tankers Hit in Persian Gulf Mine Blasts
slides.body: An oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, followed by Iranian claims of a third vessel ablaze. The attacks drove global oil prices higher, stoking fears of widespread shipping disruptions.

slides.scene: French riot police holding protective shields facing a smoky Parisian boulevard illuminated by burning barricades and emergency lights.
slides.headline: Mass Riots and Arrests Grip French Cities
slides.body: French police detained nearly 2,400 people following widespread riots and looting sparked by soaring living costs and global oil spikes. President Emmanuel Macron rejected his interior minister's resignation, vowing a severe crackdown to restore order nationwide.

slides.scene: Plumes of dark smoke rising over an urban skyline following ballistic missile strikes on industrial and power installations under a gray sky.
slides.headline: Russian Ballistic Missiles Strike Kyiv Energy Grid
slides.body: Russian ballistic missiles struck critical infrastructure in Kyiv, killing one person and injuring eight others while damaging a metro station. Ukrainian officials warned that severe United States limits on intelligence sharing are actively hindering timely missile warnings.

slides.scene: Emergency response vehicles with flashing red beacons surrounding a blackened, burning military barrack structure on a vast base compound.
slides.headline: Four Dead in Canadian Military Base Fire
slides.body: A fast-moving fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta killed four service members and left dozens injured. The blaze overwhelmed local medical facilities with casualties, prompting an urgent investigation into the rapidly spreading fire's cause.

slides.scene: Healthcare workers in high-visibility vests and gloves administering hand sanitizer to local residents at an outdoor field checkpoint.
slides.headline: Ebola Outbreak Expands Across DR Congo
slides.body: The fast-moving Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to an eighth province. Health authorities are rushing medical personnel and containment supplies to the new region to prevent uncontrolled viral transmission.

slides.scene: Rows of glowing server racks inside an advanced computing center emitting high-tech blue light against clean industrial architecture.
slides.headline: China GDP Beats Forecasts via AI Boom
slides.body: China's economic growth accelerated past expectations last quarter, powered by an export surge in artificial intelligence hardware and technology. Robust global demand for advanced components successfully offset persistent domestic headwinds across real estate and consumer spending.
